about: The website's stash-tab list beside the API's listing, one league each, read 2026-09-07 (T24, docs/design/trade-ground-truth.md). `web` is what the site's stash view holds, trimmed to number, id, name and type (image URLs, colours and selection dropped); `api` is the same league's listing as the store holds it: the id the API gives (a prefix of the website's), the parent (a folder or a map/unique tab), the type and the listing index. The website lists top-level tabs and folder children in stash order, numbered from 0, folders and substashes absent; its link writes Stash<i + 1>. Pinned by t24_stash_numbers_match_the_websites_own_list (shop.rs).
